# Inspect Sentinel

> Monitors and control protocols that watch agents and intervene in their execution.


## Basics

- [Welcome](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_sentinel/index.html.md): Run monitors and protocols before and after each tool call and model call that an Inspect agent makes.
- [Tutorial](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_sentinel/tutorial.html.md): Build up a sentinel step by step: a rule, an LLM monitor, the two combined, and a person deciding escalated tool calls.
- [Log Viewer](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_sentinel/transcript.html.md): What a sentinel records in the log, how Inspect View shows it on each tool call, and how to read the records in code.

## Components

- [Stages and Steps](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_sentinel/stages.html.md): The four points in the agent loop where monitors and protocols run, and what the step at each one holds.
- [Monitors](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_sentinel/monitors.html.md): Writing monitors: functions that look at a step and report a suspicion score.
- [LLM Monitors](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_sentinel/llm-monitors.html.md): Monitors that ask a model to score each step, through context.host.score() or context.host.generate().
- [Protocols](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_sentinel/protocols.html.md): Protocols decide what happens at each step: the built-in protocols, rules, and writing your own.
- [Human Decisions](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_sentinel/human-decisions.html.md): Asking a person to decide about a step with human(), and handling escalations with handle_escalation().
- [State](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_sentinel/state.html.md): Keeping per-sample state across the steps of a sample with context.store_as().

## Running

- [Configuration](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_sentinel/configuration.html.md): Giving a task its sentinel in Python, in a YAML or JSON file, or on the command line, and how the sentinel is recorded in the log.
- [Approval and Review](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_sentinel/approval.html.md): How a sentinel relates to Inspect's tool approval and tool result review, and the order they run in around a tool call.

## Development

- [Replay](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_sentinel/replay.html.md): Measuring a monitor or protocol on agent runs you already have, by replaying it over their logs with Inspect Scout.

## Reference

- [Reference](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_sentinel/reference/index.html.md): Python API reference for the inspect_sentinel package.
